C08-M08-L08-F1.title: IR lab route: from alert queue to incident report
C08-M08-L08-F1.caption: The seven lab stages in the order the incident team needs them, with the kit tool or output behind each.
C08-M08-L08-F1.alt: Top-to-bottom flow of seven stages: 1 Load + alert picture (minisiem.py load and rules, triage.py); 2 Declare + start clock (noticed 08:30 UTC, CERT-In deadline 14:30 UTC / 20:00 IST); 3 Scope (hunt.py plus negative checks); 4 Timeline (one merged query, 9 rows); 5 Containment advice (ordered, owned, evidence-aware); 6 Evidence package (evidence_export.py, rebuilt SHA256SUMS, sha256sum -c, tamper test); 7 Incident report.

steps.label: 2 Declare + start clock
steps.sub: noticed 08:30 UTC; CERT-In by 14:30 UTC / 20:00 IST

C08-M08-L08-F1.note: The reporting clock runs from stage 2, so declaration comes before deep analysis.
